items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: He the one who played trombone some time with us over there.

ctx.x: Well did you know a guy named Hamp Vinson?
Hamp Vinson, yeah. That was the guy I was trying to call about in Chicago, Hamp Vinson. He the one who played trombone some time with us over there.
